scope: Generic completion-receipt reconciliation after transient response loss; no command reexecution, model calls, biological computations or provider runs.

semantics: Unique per-command nonce, argv/cwd/timeout binding and log SHA-256 required. Reconciliation uses only reads within the original deadline. Missing, mismatched or corrupt completion remains uncertain and stops further execution.
limitations: Synthetic worker loss tests and real local subprocess logging tests only.
